title: What will Donald Trump say during Midterm Rally in Kalispell, Montana originally scheduled for October 14, 2026? Coal
rules:
If 
 Donald Trump says Coal as part of Midterm Rally in Kalispell, Montana originally scheduled for October 14, 2026
, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
How this is resolved
Video of the Midterm Rally in Kalispell, Montana originally scheduled for October 14, 2026 using the live broadcast or stream.
If a consensus by Kalshi employees cannot be reached using video, internal & external (official) transcripts of the Midterm Rally in Kalispell, Montana originally scheduled for October 14, 2026 will be used.

Payout Criteria
The exact phrase/word, or a plural or possessive form of the phrase/word. 
Plural nouns occurring within proper nouns and noun phrases (e.g. names, titles, etc).
Donald Trump speaking in an official capacity.
For phrases with slashes like "Doge/Dogecoin," either word satisfies the criterion.

Doesn't count for payout
Grammatical/tense inflections are otherwise not included. 
Presence alone during a livestream is not sufficient for the market to qualify (e.g., inaudible private conversations on camera, unofficial statements picked up on a hot mic).
Except as otherwise specified, previously aired content, archival footage, and recordings captured at times, places, or events wholly separate from the featured address.

Payout for cancellations and delays
If an event is definitively cancelled or the event fails to qualify under the Payout Criterion, or any other circumstance prevents normal resolution, then the market for "Event does not qualify" resolves to Yes and all other markets will resolve to No.  
If the event is postponed, and such a postponement is announced by the end of the following calendar day to be rescheduled to a time within 14 calendar days, the markets shall remain open.

blind.reasoning: Trump regularly includes 'clean, beautiful coal' in his energy riff, made coal a 2026 White House priority, and has praised Colstrip coal workers at past Montana rallies. The rally is set for tonight with no sign of cancellation, and a single mention over an hour-plus speech is enough. The main risk is that he focuses on timber, oil and gas, or other topics, especially since Kalispell is far from coal country.
blind.falsifier: A full transcript or video of the October 14 Kalispell rally shows Trump never saying 'coal', or the rally is cancelled.

final.reasoning: The market at 0.895 probably reflects better knowledge of how often coal comes up in Trump's 2026 rallies, so I moved up from 0.80 to 0.85. A 4.5-point gap with no transcript data isn't enough edge to buy NO.
